title: Le Méridien Hotel Medina
description: A horeca lighting scheme for a five-star hotel in Madinah. Lucid shaped the atmosphere of arrival halls, ballrooms and dining spaces — balancing ceremonial warmth with visual comfort and an energy-aware, BIM-coordinated control system.
outcome: Hospitality lighting where atmosphere, guest comfort and operational control are resolved together — from grand public rooms to intimate dining.

title: Oman Culture Center
description: Lighting design for a major public cultural building in Muscat. The scheme reveals the ornate floor patterns, ceremonial halls and architectural surfaces — with calculations, control logic and documentation developed as one coordinated system.
outcome: A civic cultural landmark where light makes the architecture legible by day and ceremonial by night, calculated and documented end-to-end.

title: Bloom Living, Abu Dhabi
description: Urban and landscape lighting for a large residential community in Abu Dhabi. Lucid designed the night identity of streets, parks, shaded walks and waterfront edges — calibrated for comfort, safety and a coherent sense of place after dark.
outcome: A residential master community given a calm, legible night identity across streets, parks and water — landscape lighting as placemaking.

title: VIP Villa Muscat
description: Bespoke lighting for a private VIP villa in Muscat. From the grand staircase and majlis to corridors and living spaces, light was layered to support both formal occasion and everyday use — fully detailed and coordinated for delivery.
outcome: Residential lighting at the highest level of finish, where every layer is detailed to the architecture and the way the home is lived in.

title: Wałbrzych Old Town
scope: Local Lighting Master Plan · Full 3D Model
description: A local lighting master plan for the historic old town of Wałbrzych, developed on a full 3D city model. Lucid set the hierarchy of facades, streets and landmarks — a unified night image balancing heritage, atmosphere and energy strategy.
outcome: A whole historic centre planned as one night composition — landmark, street and facade hierarchy resolved on a full 3D model.

title: Terra Riyadh
description: A mixed signage and wayfinding system for the Terra development in Riyadh. From the brand-led reception identity to exterior totems and directories, the carrier family was engineered and BIM-coordinated from topology through to fabrication-ready documentation.
outcome: One coherent carrier family carrying a development's identity — interior to exterior, brand to BIM, concept to production file.

title: RCRC Headquarters
description: Interior signage and wayfinding for the Royal Commission of Riyadh City headquarters. A restrained, institutional carrier system — directories, level markers and identification — resolved as RFA families and coordinated against the architecture in BIM.
outcome: An institutional interior wayfinding system: quiet, precise and fully BIM-coordinated as Revit families against the building model.

title: Darin Castle, Tarout Island
description: Exterior signage and wayfinding for the heritage setting of Darin Castle on Tarout Island. Material and form were tuned to the historic stone context, guiding visitors with bilingual, durable carriers that respect the place.
outcome: Heritage wayfinding that guides without overpowering — carriers tuned in material and form to a historic stone landscape.

title: The Pulse Riyadh
description: A mixed signage and wayfinding programme for The Pulse lifestyle destination in Riyadh. Retail directories, identification and landscape signage were designed as one family and coordinated across architecture, landscape and lighting.
outcome: A lifestyle destination read as one signage language — retail, landscape and identification coordinated as a single system.

title: Jubbah UNESCO Site
description: Wayfinding for the Jubbah UNESCO rock-art site and tourism village in the Hail region. Lucid structured the visitor journey across a sensitive desert landscape — orientation, interpretation and identity carriers designed to sit quietly within the heritage context.
outcome: A UNESCO heritage journey structured for visitors — orientation and interpretation designed to sit quietly in a sensitive desert landscape.
